name: Changchun UP Optotech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Changchun UP Optotech Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of optoelectronic measurement and control equipment products in China. The company offers new medical instruments, optical materials, grating encoders, and high-performance carbon fiber composite materials, as well as provision of technology development, technical consulting, and technical services. It also provides optoelectronic theodolite optomechanical subsystems, aerospace camera optomechanical subsystems, new radar antenna mounts, precision turntables, dual-use medical testing instruments, grating encoders, missile and rocket structural components, and K9 optical glass.
